messages.subject: Understanding the genetic covariance matrix
parts:
HI there,

I have been studying up on structural equation modeling recently, and I'm hoping to gain a deeper understanding of the GenomicSEM methods. One thing that I'm struggling to understand conceptually is how the sample covariance matrix is calculated between traits. Looking at the code in the ldsc.R script is a bit confusing for me and what im looking for is more general. 

Hasuni

Hi Hasuni,
If you are interested in reading further on how genetic covariances are estimated using ldsc, you might start with https://www.nature.com/articles/ng.3406
Elliot
